data.name: Land & Sea: GoCar Tour + Speedboat Adventure
data.headline: 2 Hours • Rent a GoCar and Speedboat! • Save $30! • Must Be 21+ To Rent
data.description:
##Save $30 with the GoCar Speedboat Combo, where you get to explore San Diego in you very own GPS guided storytelling car for 2 hours and then the bay in your very own speedboat that you drive yourself and follow a tour guide!

- Save $30 and experience the best of both worlds with our Land and Sea Special! You jump in a GoCar and explore San Diego at your own pace in the world's first story telling car. Go where tour busses don't go and experience some of the best parts of San Diego that most visitors never get to see. As you drive your car will navigate, crack jokes and tell you the stories that bring San Diego to life.

- Then you get to go on a 1.5 hour Speed Boat Adventure Tour of San Diego Bay where you get to drive your very own speedboat on a guided narrated tour of the bay. Just follow the guide on this high speed adventure past nuclear submarines aircraft carriers and other fascinating things that change on every tour.

- This combo land sea adventure makes for the perfect day in San Diego. To reserve the Speed Boat Adventure portion of your tour call 619-294-5852 and give your order number. Both tours do not need to be taken on the same day. Just book the day and time of the GoCar portion you want online and call Speedboat adventures to book their tour.

meeting_point.address: 3918 Mason St San Diego, CA US 92110

data.cancellation_notes:
Cancellations are not permitted unless Trip Protection is purchased at the time of booking.

With Trip Protection, you may cancel up to 2 hours before your scheduled tour for a full refund.

No-shows or late arrivals without Trip Protection will be charged the full booking amount.

GoCar Tours reserves the right to reschedule or refund tours in the event of severe weather, safety concerns, or unforeseen circumstances.
data.booking_notes:
Use your generated codes to book the speedboat portion of your tour [here](https://fareharbor.com/embeds/book/sandiegospeedboatadventures/items/2710/?full-items=yes&flow=5219)

##Please arrive at least 15 min before your scheduled departure time. 

#Please call 619-294-5852 to reserve your speedboat adventure portion time slot.

- If you wish to keep your car longer than what you have booked for, you are welcome, but please check that it is available for you to keep and not needed by another renter. 

- Additional time is charged in 15 minute increments at our standard internet rates. 

- Please make sure you return the car before we close. Late returns are billed at $1 per minute. Please check with staff on day of rental the close time of the location. Early returns will not be refunded for unused time.

data.restrictions:
- GoCars hold a maximum of 2 people. Prices are per GoCar, not per person.
- Must be 21 years or older to rent. Must possess a major credit card and valid driver’s license (international license is not necessary). GoCars do not accommodate car seats for children.
- On the day of rental, a security deposit will be held on your credit card until the GoCar is returned. All riders must sign a standard participant agreement. Renters will have the option to purchase Collision Damage Waiver (CDW) insurance on the day of rental.
- Renters are free to extend the length of their tour on the day of rental. Additional rental time will be charged in 15-minute increments.
- Cars must be returned to rental location before dusk.
